description: This file defines a class SineOscillator which models a sine wave oscillator using a Taylor series approximation for sine calculation, extending an existing SawOscillator class in a MIDI synthesis context.

classes.name: SineOscillator
classes.description: A class representing a sine wave oscillator utilizing Taylor series expansion, built on top of a SawOscillator base class.

methods.name: fastSin
methods.description: Computes sine of the phase using a Taylor series expansion optimized for phase in the range [-0.5, 0.5], with phase wrapping.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides the render method to produce a sine wave value based on the current phase, transformed from a sawtooth approximation.
